title: Responsible by Practice
intro: Sustainability is at the core of our operations. Through responsible sourcing and efficient manufacturing, we continuously work to reduce our environmental impact.

bullets.recycled: Recycled Paper Sourcing: Approximately 60% of the paper we procure is manufactured using recycled pulp, reducing reliance on virgin fibre and helping conserve forest resources by reducing the need to harvest trees.
bullets.fsc: FSC® Certified Paper Initiatives: We source paper from responsibly managed FSC certified forests, supporting sustainable forestry.
bullets.manufacturing: Sustainable Manufacturing: We minimise waste by recovering, recycling, and reusing materials and water wherever possible.
bullets.resource: Efficient Resource Utilisation: We optimise our processes to improve efficiency and reduce environmental impact.
